payload.author: claude
payload.body: Progress: config.rs landed — full FRICK_* env parsing (every var from map §2), FrickLimits defaults, AllowedOrigin matching (exact/wildcard/apex rules), cross-field validation with exact TS FrickConfigError messages, EnvSource trait (ProcessEnv + test map). 13 tests, gate green. Remaining for this story: FrickStore facade (wire the FR-241 stores together), axum HTTP server + route table, WebSocket gateway (handshake/Hello/HelloAck/Schema, NUL-separated connection keys), session lifecycle + dev-login auth, tenancy, graceful shutdown.
